task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 test design for the OIDC login redirect loop fix.

Design the regression tests needed to prove the fixed login flow does not loop after Keycloak redirects back to the app. Cover the port-preserving OIDC discovery/authority case, callback storage persistence, and the tenant-config authority consistency case.

The tests should be executable against the real backend and real browser flow, with no mocks. Produce the test spec(s) required by the test guide.

Create the test design artifact(s) and ensure they align to the diagnosed root causes.
acceptance_criteria: Test design covers all three root causes
Test specs are real-browser / real-backend capable

result.summary: Added a focused regression test spec for the OIDC login redirect-loop fix covering tenant-config authority consistency, port-preserving Keycloak discovery, and callback state persistence.
